description: Tracked release thresholds for the runtime performance gate (U5/G6). Values are derived from a fresh local baseline plus the C7A noise/no-regression band definition (latency ceiling = fresh baseline p95/p99 x 1.25; RSS/failure floors are absolute product caps). The runner consumes this file fail-closed: missing, invalid, or digest-mismatched thresholds exit nonzero and no report is emitted. No environment-variable default caps exist; the tracked file is the only source.
privacy: Metadata-only thresholds; no prompts, credentials, or request bodies.

derived_from.baseline_source: fresh local baseline recorded on candidate hardware
derived_from.band_definition: no-regression band derived from fresh baseline; absolute floor separate (QUALITY-8)
